sn12.52:1.2: upādāniyesu bhikkhave dhammesu assādānupassino viharato taṇhā pavaḍḍhati
sn12.52:1.6: jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ soka parideva dukkha domanassu pāyāsā sambhavanti
sn12.52:2.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave dasannaṃ vā kaṭṭhavāhānaṃ vīsāya vā kaṭṭhavāhānaṃ tiṃsāya vā kaṭṭhavāhānaṃ cattārīsāya vā kaṭṭhavāhānaṃ mahā aggikkhandho jaleyya
sn12.52:2.2: tatra puriso kālena kālaṃ sukkhāni ceva tiṇāni pakkhipeyya sukkhāni ca gomayāni pakkhipeyya sukkhāni ca kaṭṭhāni pakkhipeyya
sn12.52:2.3: evañhi so bhikkhave mahā aggikkhandho tadāhāro tadupādāno ciraṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ jaleyya
sn12.52:2.4: evameva kho bhikkhave upādāniyesu dhammesu assādānupassino viharato taṇhā pavaḍḍhati
sn12.52:3.1: upādāniyesu bhikkhave dhammesu ādīnavānupassino viharato taṇhā nirujjhati
sn12.52:3.5: jātinirodhā jarā maraṇaṃ soka parideva dukkha domanassu pāyāsā nirujjhanti
sn12.52:4.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave dasannaṃ vā kaṭṭhavāhānaṃ vīsāya vā kaṭṭhavāhānaṃ tiṃsāya vā kaṭṭhavāhānaṃ cattārīsāya vā kaṭṭhavāhānaṃ mahā aggikkhandho jaleyya
sn12.52:4.2: tatra puriso na kālena kālaṃ sukkhāni ceva tiṇāni pakkhipeyya na sukkhāni ca gomayāni pakkhipeyya na sukkhāni ca kaṭṭhāni pakkhipeyya
sn12.52:4.3: evañhi so bhikkhave mahā aggikkhandho purimassa ca upādānassa pariyādānā aññassa ca anu pahārā anāhāro nibbāyeyya
sn12.52:4.4: evameva kho bhikkhave upādāniyesu dhammesu ādīnavānupassino viharato taṇhā nirujjhati
